Class SoundManager

java.lang.Object
utils.SoundManager
public class SoundManager extends Object
Singleton manager for all background music (BGM) and sound effects (SFX).

Singleton pattern

Only one SoundManager is ever created; retrieve it via getInstance(). This ensures only a single MediaPlayer is playing BGM at any time.

Resource loading

Audio resources are loaded with Class.getResource(String), which returns a jar: URL that works both in the IDE and in a packaged JAR. The old new File(path) approach only worked when the application was run from an exploded directory.

BGM vs SFX

  • BGM: a single long-running looping track managed by musicPlayer. Pre-loaded via loadMediaPlayer(String) and controlled with startBGM(String), pauseBGM(), and playBGM().
  • SFX: short one-shot clips played via playSFX(String). Each call creates a disposable MediaPlayer that destroys itself after playback ends.

    • loadMediaPlayer

      public void loadMediaPlayer(String songName)
      Prepares the BGM MediaPlayer for the named song.

      If the song is not in soundLibrary, an error is printed and the method returns without changing state. The player is configured to loop indefinitely and respects the current volume.

      Parameters:
      songName - key into soundLibrary (e.g. "BGM1")

    • startBGM

      public void startBGM(String songName)
      Starts (or restarts from the beginning) the named BGM track.

      If a different song is currently loaded, loadMediaPlayer(String) is called first to swap the track. If no player is available (e.g. the sound library was not loaded), the call is silently ignored.

      Parameters:
      songName - key into soundLibrary (e.g. "BGM1")

    • pauseBGM

      public void pauseBGM()
      Pauses the currently playing BGM without resetting its position. Call playBGM() to resume from the same point.

    • playBGM

      public void playBGM()
      Resumes playback of the currently loaded BGM from its paused position.

    • playSFX

      public void playSFX(String resourcePath)
      Plays a one-shot sound effect from a classpath resource path. A disposable MediaPlayer is created per call and disposed after playback.
      Parameters:
      resourcePath - absolute classpath path (e.g. "/sfx/ui_click.wav")
